declarations.description:
Scrolling conversation log that keeps the latest message in view, offers a jump back to it with an unread count,
and requests older history when the reader scrolls to the top. Compose it with `c2-chat-message` rows and a
`c2-chat-input` to build a chat room or chatbot.

Give the element a height (or place it in a flex column); it scrolls its own content.
declarations.name: ChatMessageList

cssParts.description: Column wrapping the start slot, the loading indicator, the default slot of messages and the empty region; sets their spacing and does not style inside assigned messages.
cssParts.name: content

cssParts.description: Region wrapping the `loading` slot and its text fallback.
cssParts.name: loading

cssParts.description: Region wrapping the `empty` slot, shown only while no messages are assigned.
cssParts.name: empty

cssParts.description: Floating button that scrolls to the latest message.
cssParts.name: jump-button

cssParts.description: Unread message count inside the jump button.
cssParts.name: badge

slots.description: Conversation rows, usually `c2-chat-message` elements. Any element counts as one message.
Content above the first message, such as a "Load earlier messages" button or a conversation intro.
slots.name: start

slots.description: Indicator shown above the messages while `loading` is set.
slots.name: loading

slots.description: Content shown while the list has no messages.
slots.name: empty

members.name: label
members.description: Accessible name of the conversation log.

members.name: hasMore
members.description: Whether older messages can be requested; enables the `load-older` event.

members.name: loading
members.description: Shows the `loading` slot, marks the log busy and holds back further `load-older` events.

members.name: jumpLabel
members.description: Accessible name of the jump-to-latest button.

members.name: following
members.description: Whether the list follows new messages, i.e. the reader is at the bottom.

members.name: atBottom
members.description: Whether the list is at the bottom and follows new messages.

members.name: unreadCount
members.description: Number of messages appended since the reader scrolled away from the bottom.

members.name: scrollToBottom
members.description: Scrolls to the latest message and follows new ones again.

members.name: expectPrepend
members.description: Marks the next resize as content inserted above the viewport.

events.name: load-older
events.description: Fired once when the reader scrolls near the top while `has-more` is set and `loading` is not. Does not bubble.

events.name: at-bottom-change
events.description: Fired when the list starts or stops following the latest message; `detail` is `true` at the bottom. Does not bubble.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the conversation log.

attributes.name: has-more
attributes.description: Whether older messages can be requested; enables the `load-older` event.

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: Shows the `loading` slot, marks the log busy and holds back further `load-older` events.

attributes.name: jump-label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the jump-to-latest button.
